h1: Fernie ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Fernie has five alpine bowls, 145 named runs and tree skiing between them, spread over more than 2,500 acres with 1,082 metres of vertical. Nine metres of snow falls in an average year and up to 37 feet in a good one, and the old brick coal town sits five kilometres down the valley.
stayOverview: The resort base sits under the bowls; the town of Fernie, five kilometres away, is a brick-fronted coal town with the restaurants and the cheaper beds.
hotelIntro: Book against the season the resort states: early December to mid-April.
rentalCars: Fernie is in the Elk Valley in south-eastern BC, about three hours from Calgary, and a car is needed between town and resort.
